goal: Allow Linux release binaries to run across any distribution, minimal container, or non-glibc system
Eliminates host glibc version dependencies and compatibility friction for node operators
reviewability: Guix builds are functional and reproducible but rely on prerequisite toolchain PRs
agreement: Broad support for static glibc binaries over alternatives like musl (theuni)
Verified portability across Alpine, NixOS, and diverse Linux environments (willcl-ark, 0xB10C, dergoegge)
Verified Guix build reproducibility and NSS name resolution behavior (willcl-ark, 151henry151, xrviv)
Approach approval and confirmed running on Alpine in production (jsarenik, hebasto)

categories.name: build
why: P2 because it produces fully portable Linux release binaries without host glibc version mismatches
Enables execution on Alpine, NixOS, scratch containers, and older distributions while preserving ASLR
Resolves a long-standing issue for release portability and toolchain improvements
